verdict.rationale: Claude Design is built around delegating design tasks directly to Claude within the product—describing a visual, refining through conversation/sliders, generating variations, and packaging handoffs are all done by the embedded Claude assistant, and this is corroborated by hands-on community reports of building shippable pages and using the handoff skill successfully. missing for 10: independent quality benchmarking of how much genuine agentic reasoning vs templated generation occurs, and some community reports note underwhelming or 'boring' outputs suggesting delegation quality varies.
